title: Light-powered ePaper screen adds art to your wall without a charger
caption:
A new electronic-paper frame called Inkanva uses indoor-light-harvesting perovskite solar cells to display art without power cords trailing down your walls. The device runs indefinitely on ambient room light by ditching power-hungry backlights. While smaller versions charge autonomously, the oversized format still requires a plug.

Source: Newatlas - Light-powered ePaper screen adds art to your wall without a charger
